questions.question: In the Martian crater-ray study, what boulder density was measured around the reference crater in February 2022?
Which earlier ILOA flight is named as the forerunner of the hosted camera now riding on Chang'e 7?
Down to what crater diameter does the new global crater catalogue for Enceladus extend?
In the validation against recovered meteorite falls, how closely did the nominal solutions reproduce the observed fall locations?
At what surface coordinates sits the Mars base that the candidate Sun-synchronous reflector orbits are chosen to illuminate?
Which radio source is singled out as one whose size was measured or constrained by the original cliff-and-ocean interference method?
What is the nominal period of the Class I halo orbit about the Earth-Sun L1 point in which Carruthers operates?
Across what mass-to-charge range did the Rosetta mass spectrometer step through integer masses in the dataset analysed here?
At which university is the science centre that calibrates the EUVST data located?
What approximate diameter does the Venezuelan circular structure have, measured across its annular plateau?
Which commensurability between two of Uranus's inner moons keeps the Belinda-Cupid-Perdita group confined?

The open-source Python framework that wraps the Roman preflight optical prescription together with an EMCCD detector simulator was used to generate a first test set of polarimetric observing sequences. Which debris disk did that test set target?

The JWST instrument whose Medium Resolution Spectrometer needs Point Fixed Pattern Corrections built from O, A and G dwarf flux calibration stars also has a low-resolution slit mode that was trialled for time-series work. Whose transit was observed in that trial?

The Geant4 response model of Solar Orbiter's STIX was checked against a persistent standard-candle X-ray source. Which other solar X-ray instrument in this corpus can point at that same source during only two time slots each year?

The lunar mission that supplied 54 two-way coherent S-band occultation intervals from 2022 also contributes the near-lunar plasma benchmark to a five-dataset survey of interplanetary Doppler noise. On what date were that survey's X-band solar-occultation observations taken?

A 2025 July-September multi-band campaign found an interstellar comet to be carbon-chain depleted, with a single prominent molecular emission. A separate multi-IFU optical spectrograph study of the same object sampled it out to what sunward distance from the optocenter?

A Python gravity package implements the same constant-density polyhedral formulation that a 433 Eros surface-hopping study relies on for its low-altitude dynamics. In that package's cost benchmark, at how many field points was the potential evaluated?
By how many metres did the compact-body scaling result for a solid aluminium sphere exceed the crater diameter that LRO actually measured after the Falcon 9 upper-stage impact?
How many of the 54 Chandrayaan-2 radio-occultation intervals fell outside the upstream solar wind?
How many simulated PLATO light curves were processed end to end across both arms of the study combined?
